text: what the fuck i found the concave shit and it doesnt make sense. check this shit out man i have the ds_bumper (driveside bumper) selected, right, now watch when i pull it out [Image #1] [Image #2]  the passenger side is pulling on shit that doesnt even exist do u see that
resolution: Diagnosed the detached bumper deformation as Mirror Edit's cross-part any-owner vertex fallback: coincident seam coordinates let unrelated passenger-side body/door vertices overwrite the intended mirrored bumper vertex. Reworked mirror pairing to choose one unique whole-part counterpart with majority reflected coverage, then constrain every twin lookup to that owner. Added a three-part coincident-seam regression proving the real counterpart moves and the unrelated owner stays fixed. test-mesh-edit and the ReleaseFast editor ship pass; the live editor still needs restart and user visual verification.
